nodes.label: Build scoped STRUCTURED_FIELD / EXTRACTIVE_STATEMENT evidence graph
Emit canonical server-owned excerpts and citations

edges.action: request secure fetch of a public source URL
issue an opaque evidence_ref bound to fetched server-owned text
submit only the evidence_ref returned by this instance's fetch_evidence and bounded search terms
authenticate, validate, and delegate span selection
resolve fetched evidence and deterministically select bounded exact source spans
return opaque evidence_span_refs with canonical source URL, exact server excerpt, and offsets
submit explicit verification modes and span refs without caller-authored citation metadata
resolve only unexpired span refs issued by this process from fetched evidence
scope each structured assertion to selected server spans and same-source product binding
classify only deterministic structured field relations or exact extractive statements; never infer semantic paraphrase support
preserve independent source URLs, block unsupported/partial/conflicted structured claims, and retain separate exact statement citations
return server-generated claim IDs, canonical URLs, and server-owned excerpts only
return one machine-readable correction reason for eligible blocked proposals; consumer may retry once only when fetched evidence is usable and no tool/security failure occurred

authority_invariants: LLM output is proposal only; MAX Grounding owns evidence identity, source identity, exact excerpt, support status, claim IDs, and citations.
An evidence_span_ref resolves only to a span selected from a server-owned fetched document in the same process and expires with its evidence_ref or process restart.
Unknown, forged, expired, or cross-process evidence and span references fail closed.
STRUCTURED_FIELD support requires a deterministic field/value relationship in the selected server excerpt; nearby words alone do not establish a field relation.
EXTRACTIVE_STATEMENT value and citation text are copied from one selected server-owned exact span; caller prose cannot replace or concatenate excerpts.
Multiple selected spans remain separate source excerpts and citations; distinct-source counts use canonical URLs, not span counts.
Barcode, name, brand, and package facts are bound only within the same fetched canonical source when barcode binding is required.
Search snippets remain discovery evidence and cannot be resolved as fetched evidence or enter synthesis-safe claims.
Verification correction is bounded to one consumer retry for eligible proposal formatting or binding failures; there is no semantic/NLI verification and no endless loop.
Unsupported, partially supported, and conflicted claims remain excluded from authoritative synthesis.
